sources.title: NIMH — Caring for Your Mental Health
sources.use: Functioning and distress can indicate need for qualified help; US crisis and emergency routing.
sources.limits: No diagnosis, waiting period, treatment selection or universal contact number. No guarantee of service access.

sources.title: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline — What to Expect
sources.sections: Call, text and chat routes and description of contact
sources.use: US call/text/chat support; contact may include discussing safety and support.
sources.limits: No test calls, guaranteed response time, absolute confidentiality or local eligibility inferred. Linked accessibility pages not inspected; verify actual needs separately.

sources.title: NHS Every Mind Matters — Staying on top of things
sources.use: Notice what helps and revisit a plan when circumstances change.
sources.limits: No copied worksheet or video use; original two-context design is not therapy for chronic dysregulation.

sources.title: NCCIH — Meditation and Mindfulness: Effectiveness and Safety
sources.sections: Present attention, research limits, safety and Tips To Consider
sources.use: Present attention with uncertainty about effects; mindfulness must not replace or delay appropriate care.
sources.limits: No clinical efficacy estimate, neurological mechanism, new meditation prescription or change to the frozen presence protocol. Referenced studies were not separately inspected.

sources.title: NHS Every Mind Matters — Reframing unhelpful thoughts
sources.use: Separate a thought or attractive prediction from an established fact.
sources.limits: No copied thought record, video inspection or validation of the original impulse/desire exercises. No required positive thought.

sources.title: NHS Every Mind Matters — Tackling your to-do list
sources.sections: Avoidance patterns, reminders, manageable starts, suitable places and balance
sources.use: A manageable task and suitable environment can support a chosen activity.
sources.limits: No video or image used. Original audit, time limits, minimum standards and typed rules are not validated by this page. No claim of treating low mood. Rewards or extending past the bounded window are not required.

sources.title: University of Edinburgh — What? So what? Now what?
sources.use: Describe what happened, interpret cautiously and choose a proportionate next step.
sources.limits: Underlying books and diagram not inspected. Original discomfort, restraint, closure and rule-audit cases have no clinical or spiritual validation from this framework.
